title: chore(ui): retire the dead import harness and the msw testing guide
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb4AMvsQ5Sw4M7HwxMHVNGRL)_

Part of #25921: two of the open items in landing note 6579769954, "the playwright harness configs" and "the msw text in skills" (claim 6580031761, amendment 6581015226). The card stays open. The import-console config and spec stay, and every other item the card lists is untouched.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除导入向导的 harness 版 Playwright 配置、它唯一的用例和 `test:e2e:import-harness` 脚本；QA 清单里提到这个"孪生用例"的地方改成"已在 #25921 退役"；objectui 测试技能指南不再教 msw，改为教本仓库实际在用的写法（给真实 adapter 传一个 `vi.fn` 作为 `fetch`）。
- 为什么改：harness 配置要求的 `vite.live.config.ts` 在仓库里根本不存在，用例只能自我跳过，也没有任何 workflow 跑它；msw 已没有任何 package.json 声明，照指南写的测试连 import 都解析不了。
- 风险与回滚：只删死文件和改文档，不改任何运行时行为；真正在跑的 import-console 用例和 QA 配方 `qa-crm-import-console` 不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`（新示例，已在真实 adapter 上跑通）、`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`（条目 revision 8→9）、`ui/scripts/__tests__/e2e-type-check.test.ts`（Playwright 配置数下限 4→3）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n -e import-harness -e IMPORT_HARNESS -e "from 'msw" -- ui skills docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`，预期无输出（退出码 1）。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改了 `skills/**`（Tier H），需要你批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **Deleted** `ui/playwright.import-harness.config.ts`, its one spec `ui/e2e/import-harness/import-undo.spec.ts`, and the `test:e2e:import-harness` script in `ui/package.json`. The config told a runner to serve `packages/plugin-grid/demo/vite.live.config.ts` at `/live.html`; that file does not exist (`demo/` holds `index.html` and `bulk-actions.html`), so the spec could only self-skip. No workflow ran it.
- **QA checklist** (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, `RUNNER.md`): every place that named the harness twin now says it was retired on #25921: the `qa-crm-import-console` recipe's `why` and `knownGaps[0]`; and on `records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel` its `fixtures.requires[1]`, `fixtures.knownGaps[0]`, `steps[0]`, `acceptance[0].verify`, `automated.ref` and `source`. The item moves to revision 9 with a history row. History rows 7 and 8 still quote the old paths: the ledger is append-only. The import-console recipe's own steps are unchanged.
- **`skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`**: "MSW for API mocking in integration tests" becomes "A fetch double for API mocking": a `vi.fn` passed as the `fetch` of a real `ObjectStackAdapter`, naming `packages/data-objectstack/src/aggregate-rows-post-unwrap-7028.test.ts` as the worked example. "Vitest mocks for unit tests" below it is unchanged.
- **Amendment 6581015226**: `ui/scripts/__tests__/e2e-type-check.test.ts` lowers its root-config floor from 4 to 3, as its own comment asks when a config is retired; `ui/playwright.import-console.config.ts` drops the header line that named the harness config (code unchanged).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25921-objectui-testing-guide-fetch-double.md`: `@objectstack/skills` `patch`, because `skills/**` ships in that package's `dist`.

## Why

The card's 2026-10-24 census listed both items as zero-consumer surface. Re-measured at `origin/main` `d93acbbe` (hotcrm `d4ffe99`) before editing:

| name | before (files / lines) | after, at `6daa99f1` (outside history rows) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `playwright.import-harness.config.ts` | 4 / 5 | 1 (the import-console header, removed by the amendment) |
| `e2e/import-harness` | 3 / 10 | 0 |
| `test:e2e:import-harness` | 2 / 3 | 0 |
| `IMPORT_HARNESS_ORIGIN` | 1 / 2 | 0 |
| `IMPORT_HARNESS_OBJECT` | 3 / 3 | 0 |
| `vite.live.config.ts` | 2 / 4 | 0 |
| `msw` (word, any case) | 70 / 262 | 69 / 259 |
| `msw` under `skills/` | 5 lines | 2 (both say msw is gone: `data-integration.md` and its eval) |
| imports `from 'msw…'` | 2 | 0 |
| control `playwright.import-console.config.ts` | 4 files | 4 files |

hotcrm names none of the harness names. Its only `msw` hit is an `onlyBuiltDependencies` entry in its root `package.json` (noted below). The other `msw` hits in this tree are CHANGELOGs, release notes and prose about the retired MSW plugin, which this batch does not touch.

`skills/**` readings (the published bundle):

| reading | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md` lines | 370 | 363 |
| `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md` tokens (ratchet convention) | 3101 | 3101 (ceiling 3101) |
| all `SKILL.md` lines | 4529 | 4529 |
| `skills/**` lines | 19779 | 19771 |
| bundle tokens (`check-skills-token-ratchet` total) | 224069 | 224069 |

The new text was paid for by deleting the old MSW block in the same file. The ceiling did not move.

## Tests

- Before, on `d93acbbe`: `pnpm --dir ui exec playwright test --config=playwright.import-harness.config.ts --list` → `Total: 1 test in 1 file`, exit 0. Running it: `1 skipped`, exit 0.
- The guide's snippet, copied byte for byte into a throwaway test in `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/` and run with `adapter.find('contact')` against it → 1 passed (`res.data` equals the faked record). The file was deleted afterwards and is not in the diff.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` on `6daa99f1` → 1 failed / 4920 passed: the `e2e-type-check` floor. The amendment lowers that floor; after it, `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/e2e-type-check.test.ts` → 15/15 passed.
- No ablation: deletions, docs and a test floor. No tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` L62 still says "the `IMPORT_CONSOLE_LIVE` import-harness backend". It reads as a loose name for the console spec's backend, not as the retired config, and the file is append-only. Left alone.
- On the same item, `acceptance[1].verify`, `acceptance[3].verify` and `knownGaps` still say "the specs" (plural). They do not name the twin, so they were left as written. The next edit of the item can make them singular.
- hotcrm's root `package.json` lists `msw` under `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` while declaring no `msw` dependency. That is inert, in another repository, and not filed.

## Verification

Gate sweep derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`. `--ran` reconciliation: **69 derived, 68 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (run record: `/mnt/project-files/issue-25921/seat2-harness-msw-gates-ran.txt` in the project).

<details><summary>Derived gates: 68 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- Ran on `6daa99f1` (all files except the amendment's two): 57 families exit 0 in the first loop; `check:skill-examples` exited 3 (prerequisite: `@objectstack/client-react` unbuilt), then exit 0 after building it (281 marked examples type-check).
- The changeset-derived families (`check-adr-0087-registration` base and self-test, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` base and self-test, `release-rehearsal-clone` and `release-pending-publish` self-tests, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`): all exit 0.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: **NOT MEASURED**. It exits 3 because it needs every package's `dist` ("no packages/connectors/connector-imap/dist … Run `pnpm build` first"), and no full build ran here. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` covers it.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` (a ui-card gate, outside this derivation): exit 0.
- Re-run on the final head `613632fa` (after the amendment commit and a merge of 17 `origin/main` commits, none touching these files): `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`: all exit 0. The derived list on `613632fa` is identical to the one on `6daa99f1`.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` not run locally, CI's Lint jobs own it)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
